name: sol-advisor
description: Primary-agent-led routing with a human-owned control plane and opt-in built-in Cursor CDP and Grok ACP connectors.

interface.shortDescription: Keep one qualifying primary agent in charge while scenarios select native, built-in, or external providers.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol, permits GPT-5.6 Terra, rejects GPT-5.6 Luna, and requires high, xhigh, or max reasoning for architecture, root implementation, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, the primary agent declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native GPT-5.6 Luna / Max for bounded work or GPT-5.6 Terra / High for higher-risk work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-5.6 Sol / High review; full combines one selected implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Public role metadata is authoritative and missing, conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable routing evidence fails closed. The optional control plane exposes sanitized scenario metadata and disabled-by-default repository-owned Cursor CDP and Grok Leader plus ACP connectors for read-only and explicitly approved bounded-write work. Writes require provider write capability, a non-read-only scenario, current-task approval, and bounded allowed_paths; Git scope evidence fails closed. Cursor and Grok compatibility still require user-machine live smoke, and no external or paid provider is called merely because it is installed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:sol-control-plane; keep a qualifying primary agent in charge and verify every auxiliary claim.
Keep built-in and paid providers off unless the user explicitly enabled and approved the selected scenario.
